sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "Invoice_Line_Items"."order_item_id" AS e, "Customers"."town_city" AS g, AVG(("Invoice_Line_Items"."derived_total_cost" - "Invoice_Line_Items"."product_price")) AS m1 FROM "Invoice_Line_Items" JOIN "Order_Items" ON "Order_Items"."order_item_id" = "Invoice_Line_Items"."order_item_id" JOIN "Orders" ON "Orders"."order_id" = "Order_Items"."order_id" JOIN "Customers" ON "Customers"."customer_id" = "Orders"."customer_id" GROUP BY "Invoice_Line_Items"."order_item_id", "Customers"."town_city"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m1" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "Invoice_Line_Items"."product_id" AS e, "Products"."product_color" AS g, AVG((CAST("Invoice_Line_Items"."product_price" AS REAL) / "Invoice_Line_Items"."derived_total_cost")) AS m1 FROM "Invoice_Line_Items" JOIN "Products" ON "Products"."product_id" = "Invoice_Line_Items"."product_id"  GROUP BY "Invoice_Line_Items"."product_id", "Products"."product_color"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m2" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3
